speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a painful, ulcerative skin lesion on your leg; to help me determine the cause, please tell me how long this lesion has been present and if you have any fever or chills.

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old woman. The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. She recalls an ant bite at the site before the lesion developed. She has a history of anterior uveitis treated with corticosteroids 8 months ago, as well as Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (likely *Leishmania major* or *L. tropica*) given the history of an insect bite, ulcerative lesion on the leg, and immunocompromised state due to Crohn's disease and prior steroid use.
